diagnosis: 两目录对应不同正式入口，无已确认产品故障

observations.statement: accounts.bindingCapabilities describes the established account binding service. Douyin is backed by createDouyinAccountBindingStage and account.bind.start.

platforms.capabilities.list describes the separate platform-collection sourceAdapters surface. Douyin is intentionally absent there, so platforms.bind.begin returns SOURCE_UNMAPPED without contradicting the legacy account binding route.

AI fixed read catalog contains accounts.bindingCapabilities; system.features accounts domain advertises accounts.* and account.bind.start; prepare re-reads the selected platform capability and adoption reserves through the original accounts.bind.start owner.

aiChain: system.features(feature=accounts) returns the accounts domain, reads prefixes accountGroups./accounts., and action account.bind.start.
system.read accepts accounts.bindingCapabilities through the frozen assistantReadEndpoints catalog.
system.action.propose account.bind.start is schema-bound to platform and expectedGroupVersion.
owner.prepare loads the real group and accounts binding capability and rejects unavailable/non-QR methods.
adoption uses reserveInTransaction on the original account binding owner, then wakeReserved after commit; it does not call platforms.bind.begin.
securityBoundary: Catalog visibility is not execution authorization. Group/version/capability are revalidated during prepare and original owner authorization is retained during adoption.
No evidence supports changing platforms.capabilities.list Douyin to supported=true; that would falsely claim a source adapter exists.
No evidence supports removing Douyin from accounts.bindingCapabilities; the composition contains the dedicated Douyin binding stage.
evidenceStillRequiredBeforeClaimingInsta: Isolated public composition: accounts.bindingCapabilities returns Douyin QR, account.bind.start creates a group-owned queued run, status/cancel retain ownership; no cookies or secrets inspected.
AI public chain: system.features→system.read(accounts.bindingCapabilities)→proposal→explicit adoption reaches the same account.bind.start owner, with candidate remaining unexecuted before adoption.
Installed/manual QR success requires an authorized real scan and verified identity receipt. It has not occurred and must remain pending.
Separate platform-collection test must continue proving Douyin platforms.bind.begin rejects SOURCE_UNMAPPED, so future changes do not silently conflate the two surfaces.
testBoundary: Use isolated DB and stub only the external browser/login stage while retaining real services, transports, owner, group/version and receipts.
Do not hardcode a successful identity, read cookies/tokens, or treat a mocked QR stage as installed scan success.
Regression should assert both catalogs simultaneously and name their distinct operations, avoiding a superficial equality assertion.
review.conclusion: The observed difference is coherent with current architecture and does not establish an AI discovery or execution defect. T1113 can remain a diagnosis record unless a real public-chain test fails; no product write set is justified from the catalog difference alone.
